question: The analysis of the data obtained from cases of Ebola virus disease in Guinea and Sierra Leone, allows us to affirm that:

options.opa: The mortality of the infection exceeds 85%.
options.opb: The treatment is based on support measures (hydroelectrolitic replenishment i.v. and antibiotics).
options.opc: More than half of the cases correspond to health personnel.
options.opd: Gastrointestinal hemorrhage is a common cause of mortality.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Ebola virus disease has a high mortality rate" -> "Mortality rates reported in outbreaks often exceed -> 70%

CHAIN: "Ebola virus disease requires supportive care" -> "Supportive measures include hydroelectrolytic replenishment" -> "Antibiotics are used to prevent secondary infections" -> "Treatment is based on support measures" -> 85%

CHAIN: "Health personnel are at higher risk during outbreaks" -> "In Guinea and Sierra Leone, many cases were among health workers" -> "More than half of the cases correspond to health personnel is plausible" -> 70%
CHAIN: "Gastrointestinal hemorrhage is a known complication of Ebola" -> "Hemorrhagic symptoms can lead to severe outcomes" -> "Gastrointestinal hemorrhage is a common cause of mortality" -> 80%
CHAIN: "Mortality rates can vary by age group" -> "Some studies suggest higher mortality in younger populations" -> "Mortality is higher in adolescents is possible but unclear" -> 60%
analysis: The analysis of Ebola virus disease cases in Guinea and Sierra Leone indicates that the mortality rate can vary but is generally lower than 85% in most outbreaks. Supportive care is crucial, but antibiotics are not effective against the virus itself. A significant proportion of cases do involve healthcare workers due to their exposure, and gastrointestinal hemorrhage can occur but is not the most common cause of mortality. Mortality rates are higher in older adults rather than adolescents.
